items.title: 哈爾克島附近傳出爆炸聲！伊朗油輪傳遭美軍飛彈襲擊
items.title_en: Explosion Sounds Reported Near Kharg Island! Iranian Oil Tanker Allegedly Hit by US Missile
paras: 中東關鍵能源運輸通道緊張情勢再度升高。根據伊朗《法斯通訊社》（Fars News Agency）週六（5日）報導，伊朗石油運輸要地哈爾克島（Kharg Island）附近海域多次傳出爆炸聲，但目前尚未觀察到明顯煙霧或火光。
另據伊朗《光明通訊社》援引當地消息人士說法，一艘伊朗油輪在哈爾克島附近遭美軍發射的飛彈擊中。
報導指出，這起事件發生前，美伊雙方已在相關海域展開一連串密集軍事交鋒。隨著雙方報復性攻擊持續升級，連接波斯灣與外部海域的荷姆茲海峽，正面臨今年2月衝突爆發以來更加嚴峻的安全考驗。
據初步消息，油輪遇襲事件發生於5日上午，地點位於荷姆茲海峽附近的哈爾克島海域。
目前現場傳出多次爆炸聲，但附近海域尚未出現明顯煙霧或火光。遇襲油輪上的人員正在撤離，暫時沒有傷亡消息傳出。不過，由於官方尚未公布完整資訊，事件造成的實際損害程度仍不明。
荷姆茲海峽是全球重要能源運輸通道，自今年2月底伊朗戰爭爆發以來，一直是美國與伊朗雙方談判及軍事博弈的核心區域。
就在油輪遇襲前一天，德黑蘭據稱曾向荷姆茲海峽內的船隻發射反艦飛彈。不過，伊朗媒體並未公布具體攻擊目標，也未說明行動造成的損害。
相關海上軍事活動持續增加，也使荷姆茲海峽商業航運面臨更高的安全風險。
過去一週，美伊直接軍事衝突呈現持續升級態勢。
上週日，美軍對荷姆茲海峽內的伊朗火箭發射器發動攻擊。美國中央司令部（CENTCOM）當時表示，美軍針對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）布雷部隊採取「有限且精準的行動」，並指其對航道構成「迫在眉睫的威脅」。
伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊隨後證實拉拉克島（Larak Island）遭到攻擊，並宣稱將進行報復，之後對中東地區的美軍基地發動攻擊。
作為回應，美國中央司令部部隊週二再度展開攻擊，鎖定伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊的防空陣地、布雷設施、雷達系統、海上資產及通訊站點。
美方表示，此次行動是為回應伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊近期企圖攻擊荷姆茲海峽商業航運。
paras_en: Tensions have risen again along the critical Middle‑East energy transport corridor. According to Iran’s Fars News Agency on Saturday the 5th, multiple explosion sounds were heard in the waters near Kharg Island, a key oil‑shipping hub, though no obvious smoke or flames have been observed yet.
Iran’s Mehr News Agency, citing local sources, says an Iranian oil tanker was struck by a missile launched by US forces near Kharg Island.

The report notes that before this incident, Iran and the United States had already engaged in a series of intense military clashes in the area. As retaliatory attacks continue to escalate, the Strait of Hormuz – the gateway between the Persian Gulf and the open sea – is facing its toughest security test since the conflict erupted in February.
Preliminary information indicates the tanker attack occurred on the morning of the 5th, in the Kharg Island waters close to the Strait of Hormuz.

Multiple explosions were heard on site, but no clear smoke or fire has been seen in the surrounding sea. Personnel on the struck tanker are being evacuated, and no casualties have been reported so far. However, because officials have not released full details, the actual extent of damage remains unclear.
The Strait of Hormuz is a globally vital energy transit route and has been the focal point of US‑Iran negotiations and military maneuvering since the war broke out at the end of February.
The day before the tanker was hit, Tehran is said to have fired anti‑ship missiles at vessels inside the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian media did not disclose the specific targets or any resulting damage.
The buildup of maritime military activity continues to raise the security risk for commercial shipping transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
Over the past week, direct US‑Iran military confrontations have been on a steady upward trajectory.

Last Sunday, US forces attacked Iranian rocket launchers inside the Strait of Hormuz. At the time, US Central Command (CENTCOM) said the operation was a "limited and precise" strike against Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) mine‑laying units, which it described as posing an "imminent threat" to the waterway.
The IRGC later confirmed that Larak Island was hit and vowed retaliation, subsequently striking US bases in the region.
In response, US Central Command forces launched another attack on Tuesday, targeting IRGC air‑defense positions, mine‑laying facilities, radar systems, maritime assets and communications sites.
The US said the operation was conducted to counter the IRGC’s recent attempts to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 美國監管機關 啟動特斯拉Cybercab安全認證調查
items.title_en: U.S. regulators launch safety certification investigation of Tesla Cybercab
paras: 美國國家公路交通安全管理局4日（周五）宣布，對電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 旗下無人駕駛計程車Cybercab 啟動調查，以確定特斯拉對Cybercab的認證是否符合規範。
美國國家公路交通安全管理局正在審查特斯拉用於證明Cybercab符合美國聯邦機動車安全標準的認證流程和技術數據。
Cybercab是一款古銅色雙座自動駕駛計程車，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），沒有方向盤和煞車踏板。特斯拉近兩年前首次展示Cybercab。
在售價方面，Cybercab目標售價低於3萬美元，每英里營運成本控制在0.2美元以內。
依據美國EPA認證文件，Cybercab將搭載約48kWh鋰離子電池組，採用前輪驅動電機，最大功率163kW（約219馬力），整備重量僅1,412公斤，綜合工況續航約約673公里。
特斯拉在X上強調，Cybercab的目標是成為道路上最安全車款，並大力宣傳其通過原生整合最新一代StarlinkV5 衛星網路硬體，在車輛的便捷性、乘客娛樂體驗以及車隊營運連接性上實現顛覆性突破。
paras_en: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration announced on Friday the 4th that it is opening an investigation into Tesla’s (TSLA-US) driverless taxi, the Cybercab, to determine whether Tesla’s certification of the Cybercab complies with regulations.
The NHTSA is reviewing the certification process and technical data Tesla used to demonstrate that the Cybercab meets U.S. Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.
The Cybercab is a bronze‑colored two‑seat autonomous taxi equipped with scissor (or butterfly) doors and no steering wheel or brake pedal. Tesla first unveiled the Cybercab nearly two years ago.
In terms of pricing, the Cybercab is targeted to sell for under $30,000, with an operating cost of less than $0.20 per mile.

According to EPA certification documents, the Cybercab will be equipped with roughly a 48 kWh lithium‑ion battery pack, a front‑wheel‑drive motor delivering up to 163 kW (about 219 hp), a curb weight of just 1,412 kg, and an estimated combined‑cycle range of about 673 km.

Tesla emphasized on X that the Cybercab’s goal is to become the safest vehicle on the road and heavily promoted its native integration of the next‑generation Starlink V5 satellite‑network hardware, which it says delivers disruptive breakthroughs in vehicle convenience, passenger entertainment, and fleet‑operation connectivity.

items.title: 全球貨幣供應衝150兆美元新高！大宗商品走強背後「3大推力」曝光
items.title_en: Global Money Supply Hits $150 Trillion New High! Three Major Drivers Behind Commodity Strength Revealed
paras: 全球大宗商品近期集體走強，背後的關鍵推力指向持續擴張的貨幣供應。最新數據顯示，2026年6月全球廣義貨幣供應量年增10.7兆美元、年增率達7.7%，攀升至150兆美元歷史新高，連續9個月年增率超過7%，創2021年以來最長紀錄。市場分析認為，貨幣寬鬆可透過資產配置、原物料需求及美元計價等渠道，推升大宗商品價格。
數據顯示，全球貨幣供應持續快速擴張。自2000年以來，全球貨幣供應量累計增加124兆美元，複合年增率達6.9%；自2020年以來更增加50兆美元，增幅達50%，平均每年增加約7.5兆美元。
從歷史經驗來看，貨幣環境大幅寬鬆往往伴隨大宗商品價格上行。1970年代布雷頓森林體系瓦解、美元與黃金脫鉤後，法定貨幣信用受到影響，資金轉向實體資產，原油、黃金及金屬價格同步上漲。
2008年金融危機後，全球大規模寬鬆政策與基礎建設投資托底，有色金屬、橡膠及農產品等大宗商品價格也出現反彈。
2020年疫情期間，各國央行推出大規模寬鬆措施，在供應鏈中斷與貨幣供應增加的雙重影響下，原油、銅及農產品價格同樣從低點回升。

貨幣供應增加 大宗商品受三大因素推動

分析指出，貨幣供應增加之所以可能推升大宗商品價格，主要可從三個面向觀察。
首先，當貨幣供應增加，貨幣購買力面臨貶值壓力，而原油、黃金、金屬及農產品等實體資產具有一定抗通膨特性，因此資金可能轉向大宗商品等實物資產。
其次，寬鬆貨幣環境有助刺激經濟活動。企業擴大生產、居民消費增加，都可能進一步帶動原材料需求，推升大宗商品價格。
第三，由於全球貿易大量採用美元計價與結算，美元貨幣供應增加，也可能對以美元計價的大宗商品價格形成直接影響。
在全球廣義貨幣供應量攀升至歷史高點之際，大宗商品價格同步走強，也使貨幣環境成為觀察商品市場的重要因素。
從這個角度來看，全球貨幣供應持續擴張，可能透過資產配置、經濟需求及美元計價等渠道，成為近期大宗商品價格走勢的重要背景。
paras_en: Global commodities have recently rallied across the board, driven by a key force: the continuously expanding money supply. The latest data show that in June 2026 global broad money grew by $10.7 trillion year‑over‑year, a 7.7% annual increase, pushing total broad money to a historic $150 trillion. The growth rate has stayed above 7% for nine consecutive months, the longest streak since 2021. Analysts say monetary easing can lift commodity prices through asset allocation, raw‑material demand and dollar‑denominated pricing channels.

The data indicate that global money supply keeps expanding rapidly. Since 2000, total global money has risen by $124 trillion, a compound annual growth rate of 6.9%; since 2020 it has added another $50 trillion, a 50% increase, averaging about $7.5 trillion per year.

Historical experience shows that a markedly loose monetary environment often coincides with rising commodity prices. After the collapse of the Bretton Woods system in the 1970s and the decoupling of the dollar from gold, fiat‑currency credibility was shaken, prompting funds to shift into real assets, and oil, gold and metal prices rose together.
Following the 2008 financial crisis, massive global easing policies and infrastructure investment underpinned a rebound in commodities such as base metals, rubber and agricultural products.

During the 2020 pandemic, central banks launched large‑scale easing measures. The dual impact of supply‑chain disruptions and increased money supply saw oil, copper and agricultural prices climb back from their lows.

Increasing Money Supply Fuels Commodities Through Three Main Factors
The analysis points out that the rise in money supply may lift commodity prices, which can be observed from three perspectives.

First, as money supply grows, purchasing power faces depreciation pressure, and tangible assets like oil, gold, metals and agricultural products have some inflation‑hedging qualities, so capital may shift toward physical commodities.

Second, a loose monetary environment helps stimulate economic activity. Expanded corporate production and higher consumer spending can further boost demand for raw materials, pushing commodity prices higher.
Third, because global trade is largely priced and settled in dollars, an increase in dollar money supply can directly affect the prices of dollar‑denominated commodities.
As global broad money reaches a historic peak, commodity prices are strengthening in tandem, making the monetary environment a key factor to watch in commodity markets.
From this viewpoint, the ongoing expansion of global money supply may influence recent commodity price trends through asset allocation, economic demand and dollar‑pricing channels.

items.title: 貝森特預測伊朗戰事落幕：油價最低40美元 美債殖利率跟著降
items.title_en: Biden Predicts End of Iran Conflict: Oil Prices Could Drop to $40, U.S. Treasury Yields Follow Suit
paras: 美國財長貝森特表示，一旦伊朗衝突落幕，油價最低可能暴跌至每桶40美元，並使近期攀抵多年高點的債券殖利率回落。
貝森特在周五播出的Steve Bannon專訪中表示：「我們終將度過這場伊朗衝突，屆時油價可望回落。」他說：「此後石油市場將嚴重供過於求，隨著大量供給陸續上線，原油價格可能跌至每桶50美元，甚至40美元。」
貝森特並未說明戰爭可能何時結束，目前也幾乎沒有跡象顯示戰事短期內可望落幕。美國眾議院軍事委員會一名共和黨議員本周形容，當前軍事情勢已「陷入僵局」。
在美國與伊朗本周稍早相互發動軍事攻擊後，布蘭特原油周五交投於每桶95美元上方，接近7月以來高點；西德州中級原油則報每桶約91美元。近幾周能源價格上漲，加劇市場對通膨的疑慮，也推升全球指標公債殖利率。美國10年期公債殖利率本周升至2023年以來最高水準。
貝森特表示：「如果仔細觀察就會發現，利率與油價的相關性已達前所未見的高點。伊朗衝突終將結束，屆時利率與整體通膨的飆升情勢都會降溫。」
貝森特也淡化挪威主權財富基金擬減持美國公債的重要性。該基金是全球規模最大的主權財富基金之一，根據彭博分析，這項提案可能意味其美國公債持有部位將減少750億美元。
貝森特說：「他們只是希望透過其他美國資產提高收益率。」他表示，如果挪威主權財富基金有意買進房利美、房地美及吉利美發行的債券，「我完全支持」。
房利美與房地美是由美國政府特許設立的兩大房貸機構，吉利美則是另一家聯邦住房金融機構。這些機構發行的債券通常較美國公債提供更高的收益率。
在美國政府大舉舉債之際，挪威基金可能減持美債的消息，恐進一步加深市場對投資人承接美國政府債務意願的疑慮。美國一項聯邦債務衡量指標近期已突破創紀錄的40兆美元。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said that once the Iran conflict ends, oil prices could plunge to as low as $40 a barrel, which would also pull down bond yields that have recently climbed to multi‑year highs.

Yellen told a Steve Bannon interview aired on Friday, "We will eventually get through this Iran conflict, and then oil prices are expected to fall." She added, "After that the oil market will be severely oversupplied, and as large supplies come online, crude could drop to $50 a barrel, even $40."

Yellen did not specify when the war might end, and there are currently few signs that the fighting will conclude in the short term. A Republican member of the House Armed Services Committee described the situation this week as "stalemated."

After the United States and Iran launched reciprocal military strikes earlier this week, Brent crude traded above $95 a barrel on Friday, near its July high, while West Texas Intermediate was around $91 a barrel. Recent weeks of rising energy prices have heightened inflation concerns and pushed up global benchmark sovereign yields, with the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield climbing to its highest level since 2023 this week.

Yellen said, "If you look closely, the correlation between rates and oil prices has reached an unprecedented high. The Iran conflict will eventually end, and then both rates and overall inflationary pressure will cool down."

Yellen downplayed the significance of Norway’s sovereign wealth fund’s plan to trim its U.S. Treasury holdings. The fund, one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds, could cut its U.S. Treasury position by about $75 billion, according to Bloomberg analysis.

She said, "They simply want to boost yields by shifting into other U.S. assets." Yellen added that if Norway’s sovereign wealth fund wishes to buy bonds issued by Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and Ginnie Mae, "I am fully supportive."

Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are the two government‑chartered mortgage enterprises, while Ginnie Mae is another federal housing finance agency. Bonds issued by these entities typically offer higher yields than U.S. Treasuries.

Amid the U.S. government’s large‑scale borrowing, news that the Norwegian fund may reduce its Treasury holdings could further deepen market doubts about investors’ willingness to take on U.S. government debt. A federal debt metric in the United States has recently surpassed a record $40 trillion.

items.title: 川普特使帶停戰方案抵俄 普丁下令對基輔停火3天
items.title_en: Trump Envoys Bring Ceasefire Proposal to Russia, Putin Orders 3-Day Ceasefire Over Kyiv
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁下令，俄軍暫停空襲基輔3天。美國特使魏科夫（Steve Witkoff）與庫許納（Jared Kushner）已抵達莫斯科展開會談，之後並準備前往烏克蘭首都基輔。
克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫證實，俄方已收到消息，基輔也將停火3天。魏科夫與庫許納周六抵達莫斯科，普丁計劃與兩人會面。
美國特使魏科夫與庫許納周六抵達莫斯科，帶著一項終結多年烏克蘭戰爭的提案，但俄羅斯釋出的訊號顯示，雙方取得突破的可能性不高。
佩斯科夫周六警告，各界不應對美方提案過早下結論，應等待普丁與魏科夫、庫許納會面後再作判斷。
據接近克里姆林宮的人士透露，外界對此行期待極低。魏科夫與庫許納先前幾次訪俄均未取得進展，目前也沒有理由相信兩人這次帶來的方案能獲俄方接受。
消息人士表示，俄羅斯總統普丁只願依照自身條件停戰，而莫斯科認為俄軍在戰場上占有優勢，因此開出的條件也愈發強硬。由於涉及敏感議題，相關人士要求匿名。
美國總統川普周五在白宮橢圓形辦公室表示，兩名特使「將帶著一項結束戰爭的提案」，但未進一步說明內容。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周五深夜在社群平台X表示，庫許納與魏科夫計劃周日前往烏克蘭，這將是兩人自戰爭爆發以來首度訪烏。
澤倫斯基表示，基輔的目標是讓這次訪問「盡可能具有建設性且充實」。在美方官員訪問所需期間，烏克蘭不會發動空襲，並期待俄羅斯採取對等行動。
與此同時，烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部周六表示，俄軍夜間向烏克蘭發射伊斯坎德-M與KN-23彈道飛彈，並出動167架攻擊型無人機。俄羅斯國防部則稱，攻擊目標包括第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克州的鋼鐵廠，以及基輔郊外霍斯托梅爾機場附近的燃料庫。
澤倫斯基表示，俄軍夜間對基輔及鄰近鮑里斯皮爾機場發動的攻擊帶有「示威意味」。
他在X平台發文指出：「顯然，俄羅斯攻擊這些機場，是對美方可能搭機前往烏克蘭、並在基輔機場或鮑里斯皮爾機場降落等相關討論與準備工作的回應。俄羅斯與伊朗的『見證者』無人機，就是對美國外交行動的回應。」
澤倫斯基補充表示：「烏克蘭有意推動和平早日到來。」
不過，了解基輔方面想法的人士表示，烏克蘭對魏科夫與庫許納此行能否帶來實質進展同樣感到悲觀。美國特使預料將再次提出先前的構想，例如把頓巴斯設為經濟自由區，但俄羅斯已拒絕這項提議。
烏克蘭也持續發動空中攻勢。俄羅斯國防部表示，俄軍在包括莫斯科在內的9個地區，共擊落53架烏克蘭無人機。烏方無人機活動較近日略為減少，此前基輔部隊曾出動數百架無人機攻擊俄羅斯境內目標。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered a three‑day pause to air strikes on Kyiv. U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow for talks and are set to travel to the Ukrainian capital afterward.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed that Russia has received the message and Kyiv will also observe a three‑day cease‑fire. Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow on Saturday, and Putin plans to meet them.
U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow on Saturday with a proposal to end the years‑long war in Ukraine, but signals from Russia suggest the chances of a breakthrough are low.
Peskov warned on Saturday that all parties should not jump to conclusions about the U.S. proposal and should wait for Putin’s meeting with Witkoff and Kushner before judging.

Sources close to the Kremlin say expectations for the visit are extremely low. Previous trips by Witkoff and Kushner to Russia yielded no progress, and there is no reason to believe this time’s plan will be accepted by Moscow.

According to insiders, President Putin will only agree to a cease‑fire on his own terms, and Moscow, believing its forces have the battlefield advantage, is making increasingly hard‑line demands. The sources asked to remain anonymous because of the sensitivity of the issue.
President Donald Trump told reporters in the Oval Office on Friday that the two envoys “will bring a proposal to end the war,” without providing further details.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky posted on X late Friday, saying Kushner and Witkoff plan to travel to Ukraine on Sunday, which would be their first visit since the war began.

Zelensky said Kyiv’s goal is to make the visit “as constructive and substantive as possible.” During the U.S. officials’ stay, Ukraine will not conduct air strikes and hopes Russia will take reciprocal actions.

At the same time, Ukraine’s General Staff said Russian forces launched Iskander‑M and KN‑23 ballistic missiles at night and deployed 167 attack drones. The Russian defence ministry said the targets included a steel plant in Dnipropetrovsk region and a fuel depot near Hostomel airport outside Kyiv.
Zelensky said the nighttime Russian attacks on Kyiv and the nearby Boryspil airport were “demonstrative.”

He wrote on X: “Clearly, Russia’s attacks on these airports are a response to possible U.S. plans to fly into Ukraine and land at Kyiv or Boryspil, and to related discussions and preparations. Russia’s and Iran’s ‘witness’ drones are a reply to U.S. diplomatic actions.”
Zelensky added: “Ukraine is keen to push peace forward as soon as possible.”

However, people familiar with Kyiv’s thinking say Ukraine is equally pessimistic about whether Witkoff and Kushner can achieve any substantive progress. The U.S. envoys are expected to repeat earlier ideas, such as turning Donbas into a free‑trade zone, which Russia has already rejected.

Ukraine continues its air campaign. Russia’s defence ministry said Russian forces shot down 53 Ukrainian drones across nine regions, including Moscow. Ukrainian drone activity has slightly decreased recently after Kyiv deployed hundreds of drones to strike targets inside Russia.

items.title: 福斯大砍10萬人！受中國電動車、關稅衝擊：2035年車型砍半、4座德國廠停產
items.title_en: Volkswagen Slashes 100,000 Jobs Amid Chinese EV and Tariff Pressures: Halves Model Lineup by 2035, Stops Production at 4‑Seat German Plant
paras: 面對中國車企競爭加劇、美國關稅壓力及電動車需求變化，德國汽車巨頭福斯集團（Volkswagen）宣布啟動成立89年來最大規模的轉型重組計畫，預計2030年前再裁減5萬個職位，連同先前公布的裁員計畫，總裁員人數將達10萬人，約占整體員工15%，同時大幅精簡車型與資產布局。
福斯集團近日宣布，董事會已批准「未來計畫2030」相關重組方案，未來將精簡旗下業務及資產組合，並計畫到2035年將全集團車型陣容縮減50%。
福斯旗下品牌包括福斯汽車、奧迪（Audi）、保時捷（Porsche）及賓利（Bentley）等，此次重組將涵蓋集團整體產品布局。
根據《衛報》報導，這項成本削減計畫獲福斯監事會一致通過，此前資方與擁有65萬名會員的工會曾因裁員計畫陷入緊張對峙。
根據規劃，福斯還將停止4座德國工廠的汽車生產，至於相關廠區未來用途，目前仍在研究中。
福斯表示，這項計畫是集團歷史上最具戰略意義的轉型方案之一，目標是推動產品全面更新，同時大幅降低人力成本，以恢復企業競爭力。
福斯集團執行長布魯姆（Oliver Blume）指出，擴大裁員是根據經濟現實調整員工規模的重要措施，公司未來數年也將投入數百億美元，強化旗下品牌的吸引力與競爭力。

福斯德國員工人數已持續下降

福斯大幅縮減人力，與德國生產成本及人均產能劣勢有關。根據《華爾街日報》對福斯數據的分析，福斯每生產一輛車所需的員工數量高於競爭對手，而此次改革也將涉及管理職位削減。
福斯最新數據顯示，集團在德國的員工人數已從2023年的27.5萬人，降至今年6月的25.4萬人。
《紐約時報》指出，福斯是全球最大汽車製造商之一，也是德國製造業的重要象徵，但企業目前面臨的困境，也被視為歐洲工業產業壓力的縮影。
過去數十年，福斯的成長高度依賴中國市場，但隨著中國成為全球最大的汽車及電動車生產國，中國市場競爭環境已出現變化，福斯在當地銷量下滑，也對獲利造成壓力，去年上半年稅後利潤因此下降30%。
《美聯社》分析指出，汽車與其他高價值商品長期以來是德國經濟的核心，然而其品質優勢逐漸被中國出口汽車趕上，後者價格還更低，導致德國經濟受明顯衝擊。
福斯財務主管安特利茲（Arno Antlitz）表示，在中國整體市場萎縮20%，同時中國競爭對手持續增加出口的情況下，福斯必須降低成本。
除了中國市場競爭，美國關稅政策也進一步增加福斯在美國市場的壓力。由於福斯在美國缺乏大型製造設施，其在當地銷售的車型受到的關稅衝擊尤其明顯。
布魯姆近期也坦言，關稅、新競爭者及地緣政治風險，正讓整個汽車產業承受巨大壓力。

德國工廠生產成本遠高於中國

福斯內部成本數據也凸顯德國工廠與海外廠區之間的差距。德國《經濟周刊》報導，其取得一份福斯集團內部文件，內容比較德國、葡萄牙及中國工廠的生產成本、工時、病假率與電力成本等數據，顯示德國工廠整體生產成本明顯高於海外廠區。
其中，德國埃姆登（Emden）工廠製造環節每小時勞動力成本達74歐元，相較之下，中國天津工廠僅12歐元。以單輛汽車計算，埃姆登工廠出廠成本達4850歐元，天津工廠則為1078歐元。
在人均產能方面，埃姆登工廠每名員工年產29輛車，天津工廠則達51.3輛。也就是說，埃姆登工廠承擔更高生產成本的同時，人均產能卻低於天津廠。
根據該份內部文件，福斯評估若關閉德國境內工廠，到2038年可能帶來29億歐元淨收益；若持續維持營運，則可能造成13億歐元淨虧損。
在此次最新宣布的約5萬個裁員職位中，德國職位占比超過一半，顯示降低德國生產成本已成為福斯重組計畫的重要一環。
paras_en: Facing intensified competition from Chinese carmakers, U.S. tariff pressures and shifting EV demand, German automotive giant Volkswagen Group announced the launch of its largest transformation and restructuring plan in its 89‑year history, aiming to cut another 50,000 jobs by 2030. Combined with earlier layoff announcements, total job cuts will reach 100,000, about 15% of its workforce, while dramatically streamlining its model range and asset portfolio.

Volkswagen recently disclosed that its board has approved the “Future Plan 2030” restructuring package, which will trim the group’s business and asset mix and aims to reduce the total model lineup by 50% by 2035.
The group’s brands include Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche and Bentley, and the restructuring will affect the overall product layout across the entire conglomerate.

According to The Guardian, the cost‑cutting plan was unanimously approved by Volkswagen’s supervisory board after a tense standoff between capital owners and unions representing 650,000 members over earlier layoff proposals.
Under the plan, Volkswagen will halt car production at its four‑seat German plant, with the future use of the site still under study.

Volkswagen said the initiative is one of the most strategically significant transformation programmes in the company’s history, aimed at a full product refresh while sharply lowering labour costs to restore competitiveness.

CEO Oliver Blume noted that expanding layoffs is a necessary response to economic realities, and the company will invest several hundred billion dollars over the coming years to boost the appeal and competitiveness of its brands.

Volkswagen’s German workforce has been steadily shrinking, a trend linked to high domestic production costs and lower per‑capita productivity. Wall Street Journal analysis shows Volkswagen requires more staff per vehicle than rivals, and the reform will also cut management positions.
Latest figures show the group’s German employee count fell from 275,000 in 2023 to 254,000 as of June this year.

The New York Times pointed out that while Volkswagen is one of the world’s largest automakers and a symbol of German manufacturing, its current woes reflect broader pressures on Europe’s industrial sector.

For decades Volkswagen’s growth relied heavily on the Chinese market, but as China has become the world’s largest producer of cars and EVs, competition has intensified, sales have slipped and after‑tax profit fell 30% in the first half of last year.
The Associated Press noted that automobiles and other high‑value goods have long been the backbone of the German economy, but China’s improving quality and lower prices are hitting Germany hard.
Finance chief Arno Antlitz said that with the Chinese market contracting 20% overall and Chinese rivals expanding exports, Volkswagen must cut costs.

In addition to Chinese competition, U.S. tariff policy is adding pressure in the United States, where Volkswagen lacks large manufacturing facilities and therefore feels tariff impacts on its sold models more acutely.
Blume recently admitted that tariffs, new competitors and geopolitical risks are placing enormous strain on the entire automotive industry.

German factory production costs far exceed those in China, internal cost data highlight the gap between domestic and overseas plants. Wirtschaftswoche obtained a Volkswagen internal document comparing production costs, hours, sick‑leave rates and electricity costs across Germany, Portugal and China, showing German plants are markedly more expensive.
At the Emden plant in Germany, hourly labour costs reach €74, versus just €12 at Volkswagen’s Tianjin plant in China. Per vehicle, Emden’s cost is €4,850 compared with €1,078 in Tianjin.
In terms of per‑capita output, Emden produces 29 cars per employee per year, while Tianjin reaches 51.3 cars, meaning Emden bears higher costs while delivering lower productivity.
The internal paper estimates that closing German plants could generate a net gain of €2.9 billion by 2038, whereas keeping them open could result in a €1.3 billion net loss.
Of the roughly 50,000 newly announced layoffs, more than half are in Germany, underscoring that reducing German production costs is a central element of Volkswagen’s restructuring plan.

items.title: 美債殖利率為何飆升？華爾街與Fed說法南轅北轍
items.title_en: Why Are U.S. Treasury Yields Soaring? Wall Street and the Fed Offer Opposite Explanations
paras: 隨著長天期債券殖利率攀上新高，聯準會（Fed）官員與華爾街對這波歷史性漲勢背後的驅動因素，出現明顯分歧。
Fed官員認為，美國經濟展現驚人韌性、成長動能強勁，證明利率走高有其合理性；但交易員描繪的景象更令人不安，將殖利率上升歸因於頑固通膨、能源價格飆漲及政府債務膨脹交織而成的劇烈風暴。
美國10年期公債殖利率本周一度升至4.814%，創2023年11月以來最高，隨後回落；30年期公債殖利率則報5.12%，同樣低於本周稍早高點。與此同時，中東軍事攻擊再起，帶動油價突破每桶95美元。
Fed：經濟強勁推升殖利率
紐約聯準銀行總裁、同時擔任聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）主席的威廉斯（John Williams）本周表示，美國經濟強勁、前景正向，加上人工智慧（AI）、資料中心及整體科技領域的大規模投資，是推升殖利率的主因。
威廉斯周三接受CNBC訪問時表示：「我認為，這更多反映經濟的強勁程度。我們並未從中看到通膨補償因素。經濟強勁時，為這類投資籌措資金的成本往往會上升，因此我主要是從這個角度看待。」
他說：「這其實不是金融情勢影響經濟，而是經濟正在影響金融情勢。」
威廉斯也承認，在油價上漲與中東衝突影響下，投資人持有長天期債券時，正要求額外補償，也就是更高的期限溢酬。
Fed主席華許（Kevin Warsh）同樣主張，長天期債券殖利率上升是經濟強勁所致。他上周五在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾發表演說時，描繪出穩健的經濟圖景，並指出過去四季企業資本投資成長9%，消費支出保持韌性，企業獲利也相當強勁。
同樣出席傑克森霍爾會議的國際貨幣基金（IMF）前首席經濟學家羅戈夫（Ken Rogoff）則認為，長天期債券殖利率只是回歸正常水準。目前的經濟成長，是接續在一段經濟學家預測成長將長期停滯、也就是所謂「長期停滯」的時期之後。
華許周一宣告「長期停滯」時代已經結束。他將這種曾經占據學界主流的共識形容為「所有好東西都已經被發明出來」，並表示全球投資熱潮正帶領經濟進入一個由長期成長主導的新階段。
華爾街憂通膨、赤字與發債潮
華爾街的說法卻截然不同。經濟學家與交易員將長天期債券殖利率上升，歸因於財政赤字擴大、通膨推升全球借貸成本、美元走弱，以及科技公司為籌措資料中心與其他AI建設資金而大舉發債，進一步與美國公債爭奪資金。
FedWatch Advisors投資長埃蒙斯（Ben Emons）認為，債券市場的資金競爭才是最大因素。大型科技公司為AI建設發行公司債，對投資人而言，已成為美國公債以外相當具有吸引力的選擇。
埃蒙斯向Yahoo Finance表示：「這與通膨、對Fed政策動向的預期，甚至財政赤字的關係都比較小，儘管赤字仍是問題。真正的原因是，目前經濟成長速度遠快於過去幾年，而隨著這些債券發行與投資陸續到來，成長還會進一步加速。」
投資研究公司True Insights創辦人布洛克蘭（Jeroen Blokland）則將焦點指向剛突破40兆美元的美國政府債務。
他在社群平台X發文表示：「全球債券殖利率已升至2008年以來最高。但對於『以前也曾經歷過，沒有理由擔心』這種說法，我會非常謹慎。因為有一件事肯定不同，那就是必須支付這些殖利率的政府未償債務規模。如今的預算赤字看起來也與2008年截然不同，直白地說，就是糟糕得多。」
油價升高加劇通膨風險
RSM首席經濟學家布魯塞拉斯（Joseph Brusuelas）則認為，油價才是主要元凶。
他本周稍早在X發文指出：「油價上漲正帶動全球及美國債券殖利率走高。在油價持續攀升的背景下，通膨與財政永續風險形成一股強勁組合，而且始終揮之不去。」
他並表示：「如果你想知道的話，通膨並沒有悄然退場。」
埃蒙斯預期，殖利率仍將進一步上升。在經濟成長強勁的推動下，美國10年期公債殖利率年底可能遠高於5%，30年期公債殖利率則可能升至5.5%或更高。
沃勒：高赤字難以持續
Fed理事沃勒（Chris Waller）對殖利率上升原因的看法，與許多華爾街分析師相似，認為是多項因素共同作用。
沃勒周四(3日)出席路透社主辦的問答活動時表示，相當於國內生產毛額（GDP）6%的財政赤字，即使經通膨調整後仍達3%，是不可持續的。
他預期，面對更高的債務水準，投資人將要求以更高殖利率作為補償。他也提到，投資人對美元儲備貨幣地位的不確定性正在上升。
沃勒表示：「這意味著投資人正在說，『我對世界未來的走向感到有些不確定。』」
paras_en: As long‑term bond yields climb to new highs, Federal Reserve officials and Wall Street are sharply divided over the drivers of this historic surge.

Fed officials argue that the U.S. economy is showing remarkable resilience and strong growth momentum, justifying higher rates; traders, however, paint a more unsettling picture, attributing the rise to a perfect storm of stubborn inflation, soaring energy prices, and expanding government debt.

The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield this week briefly hit 4.814%, the highest since November 2023, before easing back, while the 30‑year yield was at 5.12%, also below its earlier weekly peak. At the same time, renewed Middle‑East military attacks pushed oil above $95 a barrel.
Fed: Strong Economy Drives Yields Higher

John Williams, President of the New York Fed and a member of the Federal Open Market Committee, said this week that a robust U.S. economy and a positive outlook, together with massive AI, data‑center and broader tech investments, are the main reasons yields are rising.

Speaking to CNBC on Wednesday, Williams said, "I think this reflects more the strength of the economy. We’re not seeing an inflation compensation factor. When the economy is strong, the cost of financing these kinds of investments tends to rise, so I’m looking at it from that angle."
He added, "It’s not that financial conditions are affecting the economy; it’s the economy that’s affecting financial conditions."
Williams also acknowledged that, amid higher oil prices and the Middle‑East conflict, investors holding long‑dated bonds are demanding extra compensation – a higher term premium.

Fed Governor Kevin Warsh also argues that the rise in long‑term yields is due to a strong economy. In a speech last Friday at Jackson Hole, Wyoming, he painted a picture of a solid economy, noting that corporate capital spending grew 9% over the past four quarters, consumer spending remained resilient, and corporate profits were robust.

Ken Rogoff, former chief economist of the International Monetary Fund who was also at Jackson Hole, said long‑term yields are simply returning to normal levels. He sees current growth as a continuation after a period that economists had predicted would be a prolonged stagnation – the so‑called "secular stagnation" era.

Warsh declared on Monday that the "secular stagnation" era is over. He described the once‑mainstream academic consensus as "the notion that all the good ideas have already been invented," and said a global investment boom is ushering the economy into a new phase dominated by long‑term growth.
Wall Street’s View: Inflation, Deficits and a Debt Surge

Wall Street’s narrative is starkly different. Economists and traders attribute the rise in long‑term yields to expanding fiscal deficits, inflation pushing up global borrowing costs, a weaker dollar, and tech companies issuing massive corporate debt to fund data‑centers and other AI projects, thereby competing with Treasuries for capital.

Ben Emons, a senior portfolio manager at FedWatch Advisors, believes competition for funding in the bond market is the biggest factor. Corporate bonds issued by large tech firms for AI projects have become an attractive alternative to U.S. Treasuries for investors.

Emons told Yahoo Finance, "This has relatively little to do with inflation, expectations about Fed policy, or even the fiscal deficit, although the deficit is still a problem. The real reason is that the economy is growing far faster than in recent years, and as these bond issuances and investments roll out, growth will accelerate further."
Jeroen Blokland, founder of research firm True Insights, focused on the U.S. government debt that has just breached $40 trillion.

He posted on X, "Global bond yields have risen to their highest since 2008. But I’m very cautious about the claim that ‘we’ve been here before, so there’s no reason to worry.’ One thing is definitely different – the scale of the outstanding debt that must be serviced at these yields. The current budget deficit also looks dramatically worse than in 2008 – bluntly put, it’s a lot worse."
Higher Oil Prices Heighten Inflation Risks
Joseph Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM, believes oil is the main culprit.

He wrote on X earlier this week, "Rising oil prices are pushing global and U.S. bond yields higher. With oil continuing to climb, inflation and fiscal sustainability risks form a powerful, persistent combination."
He added, "If you want to know the truth, inflation has not quietly retreated."
Emons expects yields to keep climbing. Driven by strong growth, he projects the 10‑year Treasury could end the year well above 5%, and the 30‑year could reach 5.5% or higher.
Waller: High Deficits Are Unsustainable
Fed Governor Chris Waller’s view on the rise in yields aligns with many Wall Street analysts – it’s the result of multiple factors working together.
Speaking at a Reuters‑hosted Q&A on Thursday (the 3rd), Waller said a fiscal deficit equal to about 6% of GDP, even after inflation adjustment still at 3%, is unsustainable.
He predicts that as debt levels rise, investors will demand higher yields as compensation. He also noted growing uncertainty about the dollar’s status as the world’s reserve currency.
Waller said, "That means investors are saying, ‘I’m a bit uncertain about the direction the world is heading.’"

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.

items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 印尼盾有望連續第五周上漲 寫兩年來最長連漲紀錄
items.title_en: Indonesian Rupiah Poised for Fifth Consecutive Week of Gains, Setting Two-Year Longest Winning Streak
paras: 印尼盾近日表現強勁，預計將迎來連續第五周上漲，創下兩年來最長的周度連漲走勢。
印尼盾兌美元匯率在周五(4日)亞市早盤交易中報 17,628，持續徘徊在 17,650 附近，本周美元兌印尼盾預計下跌 0.4%，有望創下自 5 月 20 日以來的最低收盤價格。
此波強勢上漲主要受到內外部因素的雙重支撐。其中，外部環境改善，市場因聯準會(Fed)官員的鴿派言論，調降了本月的升息預期。美債殖利率的回落與美元的走弱，皆為印尼盾提供了顯著的短期支撐。
內部政策也有助維持穩定，印尼央行承諾維護匯率穩定。新任印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti釋放了政策延續性的訊號，強調政策以穩定為先，並透過綜合政策助力經濟成長、維持對境外投資人的吸引力。她也提到，目前國內通膨仍處於受控狀態。
然而，市場分析也指出潛在的制約因素。華僑銀行外匯策略師 Christopher Wong 提醒，高油價與持續高企的全球殖利率依舊是潛在風險。此外，聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能干擾食品供應並推高物價，加上市場在下周公布 8 月外匯存底、消費者信心和 7 月零售銷售等數據前持謹慎態度，皆可能使後續漲勢增添變數。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah has been performing strongly recently and is expected to record a fifth consecutive week of gains, marking the longest weekly rally in two years.

The rupiah’s exchange rate against the US dollar was reported at 17,628 in early Asian market trading on Friday (the 4th), hovering around the 17,650 level. This week the dollar is projected to fall 0.4% against the rupiah, potentially delivering the lowest closing price since May 20.

The robust rise is driven by a dual boost of external and internal factors. Externally, the environment has improved as Fed officials’ dovish remarks have lowered market expectations for rate hikes this month. Falling US Treasury yields and a weaker dollar have provided significant short‑term support for the rupiah.

Domestically, policy measures are helping maintain stability. The Bank of Indonesia has pledged to keep the exchange rate steady. New governor Destry Damayanti signaled policy continuity, emphasizing stability as the priority and using a comprehensive policy mix to support growth and retain foreign investor appeal. She also noted that domestic inflation remains under control.

However, analysts point to potential headwinds. OCBC’s FX strategist Christopher Wong warned that high oil prices and persistently elevated global yields remain risks. Additionally, the El Niño phenomenon could disrupt food supplies and push prices higher, and market participants are cautious ahead of next week’s releases of August foreign‑exchange reserves, consumer confidence and July retail sales data, which could add uncertainty to further gains.

items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 全球利率預期轉向 亞洲貨幣周五普遍走強
items.title_en: Global rate expectations shift, Asian currencies broadly stronger on Friday
paras: 受到聯準會官員言論影響，全球利率預期有所轉變，帶動亞洲主要貨幣在周五普遍走強。
美國聯邦準備理事會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨持續放緩，他將支持本月維持利率不變。此番言論降溫了市場對9月升息的預期，使美元面臨壓力，美元指數本周預計下跌0.7%至99.06。市場目前正密切關注即將公佈的美國8月份非農就業報告。
在此背景下，日元表現尤受矚目，有望創下自7月底以來最強勁的單周表現，本周已經升值約2.5%。
雖然美元周五兌日元午盤上漲0.3%至156.36，但日元在盤中一度強彈至155.25，逼近7月美日聯合干預時的155.2水位。市場分析指出，日元這波升值並非源於官方直接干預，而是因為市場預期日本央行(BOJ)可能在9月17至18日的會議上採取更鷹派的立場。日本央行此前已在6月將政策利率提高至1%，市場正定價9月再次升息的極高可能性。
與此同時，其他亞太貨幣也各有波動。人民幣匯率保持平穩，受弱勢美元支撐，投資人正持續評估中國私營部門服務業數據與疲軟的官方經濟背景。紐西蘭元與澳元也跟隨央行與貿易訊號波動，美元兌紐元下跌0.3%至1.70左右(紐元約合0.59美元)，紐西蘭央行此前升息25個基點至2.75%；澳洲第二季經濟成長0.4%，澳元兌美元維持在0.72美元附近。
此外，馬來西亞央行周四宣布將基準利率維持在2.75%，美元兌馬來西亞令吉在決議後微幅上漲0.16%至4.04。韓元兌美元小幅升值0.05%，至1,355.65兌1美元，而印度盧比則延續了本周的升勢。
paras_en: Influenced by comments from Federal Reserve officials, global rate expectations have shifted, driving the main Asian currencies to broadly strengthen on Friday.

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to ease, he would support keeping rates unchanged this month. His remarks cooled expectations of a September rate hike, putting pressure on the dollar, with the dollar index expected to fall 0.7% this week to 99.06. Markets are now closely watching the upcoming U.S. August non‑farm payroll report.
Against this backdrop, the yen is attracting particular attention, poised for its strongest weekly gain since the end of July, having already appreciated about 2.5% this week.

Although the dollar rose 0.3% to 156.36 per yen at midday on Friday, the yen surged intraday to 155.25, nearing the 155.2 level seen during the July US‑Japan joint intervention. Analysts note that this yen rally is not the result of direct official intervention but stems from market expectations that the Bank of Japan may adopt a more hawkish stance at its September 17‑18 meeting. The BOJ had previously lifted its policy rate to 1% in June, and markets are pricing a very high probability of another hike in September.

Meanwhile, other Asia‑Pacific currencies showed varied moves. The renminbi remained stable, supported by a weaker dollar, as investors continue to assess Chinese private‑sector services data and a soft official economic backdrop. The New Zealand dollar and Australian dollar also fluctuated on central‑bank and trade signals, with the dollar down about 0.3% to around 1.70 NZD (≈ 0.59 USD) and the RBNZ having previously raised rates by 25 basis points to 2.75%; Australia’s Q2 growth was 0.4%, keeping the Aussie near 0.72 USD.

In addition, Malaysia’s central bank announced on Thursday that it would keep its benchmark rate at 2.75%, with the dollar edging up 0.16% to 4.04 Malaysian ringgit after the decision. The Korean won modestly appreciated 0.05% to 1,355.65 per dollar, while the Indian rupee continued its upward trend for the week.

items.title: 17兆日元空單緊張！日元升破155恐引爆踩踏 匯率直奔142區間
items.title_en: 17 Trillion Yen Short Positions Tighten as Yen Surpasses 155 Threatens a Crash, Currency Heads Straight to 142 Range
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 策略師指出，若日元匯率升破155日元兌1美元的關鍵防線，規模龐大的日元空頭部位進一步回補，可能加速日元漲勢。
Junya Tanase等策略師在研究報告中寫道：「近期價格走勢似乎印證我們的看法，即市場可能仍持有相對龐大的日元空頭部位。」若美元兌日元跌破155，「不能排除賣壓引發更多賣盤，推動日元升幅超出預期的風險。」
摩根大通估計，目前市場尚未平倉的看空日元部位約達16兆至17兆日元（約1,026億美元），若這些部位全面回補，理論上可能將美元兌日元推低至142至146區間。
這項警告發布之際，日元剛經歷自7月底日本與美國聯手干預匯市以來最猛烈的漲勢之一。美元兌日元本周稍早一度升至160.39，創該次干預以來最高，隨後急遽反轉，最低跌至155.30，距離干預後低點155.23僅一步之遙。
這波強勁漲勢主要受到市場揣測日本國家退休金基金（GPIF）可能調整資產配置，以及日本央行將加快升息步伐的預期升溫所帶動。
市場觀察人士指出，投機性日元空單回補與日本國內投資人的避險需求，進一步放大這些利多因素，也提高日元續漲迫使更多空頭部位平倉的風險。
不過，摩根大通認為，市場對GPIF與日本央行的預期「似乎有些過度」，現階段並不認為美元兌日元大幅跌破其預估的155至165區間具有很高機率。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase analysts noted that if the yen breaks the critical 155 yen per dollar barrier, the massive short positions could be further closed, potentially accelerating the yen’s rise.

Junya Tanase and other strategists wrote in a research note that recent price action seems to confirm their view that the market may still hold a relatively large short yen position; if the dollar falls below 155 yen, "selling pressure could trigger more sales, pushing the yen higher than expected."

JPMorgan estimates that the market still has about 16 to 17 trillion yen (roughly $102.6 billion) of short yen positions open; if these are fully closed, the dollar could be pushed into the 142‑146 yen range.

At the time of this warning, the yen had just experienced one of the strongest rallies since the joint intervention by Japan and the United States at the end of July. The dollar‑yen pair briefly touched 160.39 earlier this week, the highest since the intervention, before sharply reversing and falling to a low of 155.30, just one point above the post‑intervention trough of 155.23.

The strong rally was mainly driven by market speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) might adjust its asset allocation, coupled with expectations that the Bank of Japan would accelerate its rate‑hike pace.

Market observers pointed out that speculative short yen positions and domestic Japanese investors’ hedging demand further amplified these positive factors, increasing the risk that the yen’s continued rise would force more shorts to close.

However, JPMorgan believes that expectations around GPIF and the Bank of Japan are "seemingly somewhat over‑stretched," and at present does not see a high probability of the dollar‑yen falling sharply below the 155‑165 range it estimated.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國就業數據前，美元普遍下跌
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Dollar Falls Ahead of US Employment Data
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國和伊朗再爆發衝突，重燃通貨膨脹擔憂，並據報告顯示美國8月民間就業增長不及預期，可是7月工廠訂單回升，而且美國聯邦準備理事會(FED最新經濟褐皮書報告近幾周經濟活動溫和增長及就業略增加，決策者評估是否在9月15-16日會議升息，週四提供美元支撐，但標準普爾(S&P)全球調查8月日本服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)終值創五個月最快擴張速度達52.5，並據日本內閣官房長官木原稔稱，首相高市早苗政府實現經濟強勁增長和財政可持續性政策方針未變，而且彭博新聞報導，日本央行(BOJ)官員將在9月18日結束的兩天會議討論將利率從1.0%上調，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.96高點走跌。
